open_decisions: ownership.md selects 'no new language, process, service, sidecar or deployment boundary'. Private per-package Rust/Cargo workspaces, Wasm bindings and the preparation executable introduce a new in-package toolchain boundary the living plan has not selected. Required: an explicit ownership/filetree decision allocating the new leaf families (Cargo.toml, rust-toolchain.toml, Cargo.lock, semantics/, bindings/, preparation/, scripts/build-preparation.mjs, scripts/package-preparation.mjs) before any implementation lane writes them.

Platform row directs Node artifact/module staging to move to build/ (desired-tree already lists packages/cloudflare/src/build/{artifact,modules}.ts [+]); the artifact-preparation plan proposes packages/cloudflare/preparation/ + src/preparation/*.ts instead. Required: reconcile preparation/ vs build/ naming/placement with the Platform owner before P02.1/P03.1.

New conformance families (packages/cloudflare/conformance/preparation/, values/work native differential harnesses) need target-tree allocation entries; only packages/values/conformance/v1/ is allocated today.

The B4 state delta (admission/invoke/roles) postdates the filetree primary pin and merge reconciliation; its ownership review belongs to the living plan's normal post-merge reconciliation, not to this port scope record.
